title: Harness
description: Metadata for a version-controlled LLM agent harness. Supports both flat agent harnesses and team harnesses with child references.

type.description: agent-harness = single agent; team-harness = parent with child harness references

current_phase.description: Required for active project harnesses. Optional for generic templates. Example: 'Phase 1 — Core Specs'

parent_harness.description: agent-harness only: optional path to parent team harness. Omit or set null for reusable/generic child harnesses. The team harness children[] list is always canonical.

shared_memory.description: team-harness only: path to shared memory file

shared_bulletin.description: team-harness only: path to shared bulletin surface

memory_steward.description: team-harness only: agent ID responsible for writing shared memory. Default is the orchestration agent. Other agents propose updates but do not write directly.

children.description: team-harness only: paths to child agent harness files. This list is the canonical source of team membership.

activation_order.description: team-harness only: advisory v1 order for activating child agents (human-executed). Executable orchestration deferred to v2. Typical default: brainstorm → builder → reviewer → ops.
